title: Missing moeb tool: Read (system path)
description: The Claude Code Read tool was used to read start_run output saved to a system temp path outside the project working directory. moeb read_file only accepts project-relative paths and cannot read system-level paths.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to ensure start_run output fits within inline response limits or introduce a system-path read tool, eliminating the Claude Code Read dependency for accessing tool-results files.
